mechanics.claim: Vitals can be triggered by any source of damage Fiora deals, except default damage and reactive damage types.
mechanics.quote: {{as|Vitals|buzzword}} can be triggered by any source of damage '''Fiora''' deals, except those with {{tip|default damage}} and {{tip|reactive damage}} types.

mechanics.claim: Vitals will not trigger if the attack is dodged or missed while Fiora is blinded; block will not prevent a trigger.
mechanics.quote: {{as|Vitals|buzzword}} will not trigger if the attack is {{tip|dodge|dodged}} or missed while '''Fiora''' is {{tip|blind|blinded}}.

mechanics.claim: If the Vital is triggered by Lunge (Q), it can be dodged but not blocked, and triggers even if Fiora is blinded.
mechanics.quote: If the {{as|Vital|buzzword}} is triggered by {{ai|Lunge|Fiora}}, it can be {{tip|dodge|dodged}}, but it can't be {{tip|block|blocked}} and will trigger even if '''Fiora''' is {{tip|blind|blinded}}.

mechanics.claim: Striking a vital deals bonus true damage, heals Fiora, and grants her bonus movement speed.
mechanics.quote: Striking a vital deals {{as|'''bonus''' true damage}} based on the {{as|target's '''maximum''' health}}, {{tip|heals}} '''Fiora''' and grants her a burst of {{as|{{sti|movement speed}}}}.

mechanics.claim: After a Vital expires, Fiora identifies a new one on her target.
mechanics.quote: After a {{as|Vital|buzzword}} expires, '''Fiora''' identifies a new one on her target.
